description: This source file implements DNS configuration management for POSIX systems within the Chromium project, including watching configuration files, reading DNS settings, and converting system resolver state to internal DNS config structures.

classes.name: DnsConfigServicePosix
classes.description: Implementation of DNS configuration service for POSIX systems, including file watching and configuration reading.

classes.name: DnsConfigServicePosix::Watcher
classes.description: Watches DNS configuration and hosts files for changes.

classes.name: DnsConfigServicePosix::ConfigReader
classes.description: Reads DNS configuration asynchronously using libresolv.

methods.name: ReadDnsConfig
methods.description: Reads and converts system resolver state into DnsConfig.

methods.name: ConvertResStateToDnsConfig
methods.description: Converts a __res_state structure to internal DnsConfig.

methods.name: CreateSystemService
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific DNS config service instance.
